name: East Tennessee Northeast Tennessee Project
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The system row P0179 is the whole East Tennessee line, P5627 is the Ridgeline Expansion and P7809 is the System Alignment Project, so this is a separate project. A Federal Register notice from March 2010 (docket CP10-89) lists an 8.4 mile 24 inch extension, 8.0 miles of 24 inch loop, and 11.5 miles of 24 inch replacement pipe in Greene, Hawkins, Sullivan and Washington Counties, Tennessee and Washington County, Virginia. It serves 150,000 Dth per day for a Tennessee Valley Authority gas plant. A Federal Register notice from August 2010 states 16.4 miles of new 24 inch pipe plus 11.5 miles of replacement. The EIA Aug 2026 release (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 695, project name Northeastern Tennessee Project) lists 28 miles, 135 million dollars (full figure 135000000 staged), 150 MMcf/d, completed 2011-08-31, interstate. New pipe is 16.4 mi (about 26.4 km), just above the 25 km floor, so it qualifies. Length is staged as the 28 mile project total from EIA; new pipe only is 16.4 mi. Capacity is staged as the 150,000 Dth per day the notice states, not converted. Owner entity not in gazetteer by exact hit; styled as East Tennessee Natural Gas LLC; parent (Enbridge via Spectra) not verified and left blank. Start and end locations are county-level only. Route: no official GIS checked; RouteType unavailable until a route is researched. Status operating rests on EIA completed 2011; no second source for in-service date was found. Marginal on the length floor, so a reviewer may prefer monitor.
